Adds Pokémon #001–386 from Pokémon XD as 3D models for battles and the overworld, including followers, roaming Pokémon, ecology behaviors, walking and fainting animations, improved textures, shadows, and move effects, expanded two-sided realtime attack VFX, status/powder effects, barriers, traps, ground/explosion, drain/heal, multi-hit and special-move presentation. Install pairs from the same run: 368RealtimeBattleDX + 368BattlePackDX.pack, and 368ImporterDX + 368PackDX.zip. Do not mix a mod with a pack produced by a different run because the manifest verifies exact size/MD5.
